violations.text: Milk and Creams were observed held in the walk-in cooler at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC began moving milk and cream to the open-air cooler for proper cold holding at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

At the time of inspection, the walk-in cooler was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 47 degrees Fahrenheit with milk and cream observed at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Per the PIC, a soda delivery was completed just prior to inspection (door left open). PIC moved dairy items to colder refrigeration at time of inspection. PIC is to monitor unit for regaining proper ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit for proper cold holding prior to storing dairy products inside walk-in cooler. (Ambient temperature of the walk-in cooler was observed to be lowering by end of exit interview.) Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the employee bathroom. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Hand soap was supplied to the bathroom by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Milk and creamer were observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit in the walk-in cooler. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC to move milk and creamer to colder area of the walk-in cooler away from the entrance door. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The following equipment was observed in need of repair/adjustment: - The walk-in cooler was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 42-45 degrees Fahrenheit from soda side to milk side. Per the PIC, call to be made concerning defrost cycle and ambient temperature settings to ensure perishable food items maintain proper temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. The reach-in freezer unit for ice cream and novelties was observed to have a large buildup of ice below a detached condensate line. Equipment is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Paper towels were made available at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025

The floor in the built-in walk-in cooler has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris below the milk storage rack. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025
The hand-washing sink in the employee bathroom was lacking paper towels. Paper towels supplied at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/29/2024

The floor in the built-in walk-in cooler has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 01/29/2024
